# pangolin_target (Resource)

Manages a backend target on a Pangolin resource. Health checks are not yet supported by this provider. Import using the format `<resource_id>:<target_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_target.example 5:9`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_target" "example" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.resource_id
  site_id     = pangolin_site.example.site_id
  ip          = "10.0.0.5"
  port        = 8080
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Target IP address or hostname.
- `port` (Number) Target port.
- `resource_id` (Number) Resource ID this target belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Site ID this target routes through.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this target is enabled.
- `method` (String) HTTP method restriction, if any.
- `mode` (String) One of http, tcp, udp, ssh, rdp, vnc. Defaults to the resource's mode.
- `path` (String) Path match for HTTP-mode routing.
- `path_match_type` (String) One of exact, prefix, regex.
- `priority` (Number) Routing priority (1-1000).
- `rewrite_path` (String) Path to rewrite to.
- `rewrite_path_type` (String) One of exact, prefix, regex, stripPrefix.

### Read-Only

- `target_id` (Number) Server-generated target ID.
